theme_strategy: Fashion-week editorial mode. Completely abandons standard museum grids and fixed 40/60 splits. Rejects black backgrounds entirely. Each slide is an immersive 'color world' with distinct asymmetric art direction, representing the high-fashion and dynamic lifestyle of Lewis Hamilton.

primary_heading.usage: Massive, runway-style editorial headers. Often spanning off-screen or overlapping images.
primary_heading.styles: uppercase, tight tracking (tracking-tighter), mixed italic and normal words.

secondary_heading.usage: Bold structural text, chapter numbers, hard-cut typographic posters.

metadata_body.usage: Contact-sheet annotations, location tags, date stamps, technical artifact descriptors.
metadata_body.styles: uppercase, tracking-widest, small text (text-xs or text-sm).

rules: Text contrast must strictly follow the defined 'text' color for each 'world'.
Use accents for small typographic highlights, borders, or slash elements.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain overlay (mix-blend-overlay, opacity 20%) applied globally to kill the digital flatness and enhance the editorial magazine feel.
visual_enhancers.shapes: Use CSS clip-path for harsh diagonal cuts and asymmetric image masks.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid contrasting borders on images for the 'contact sheet' and 'artifact' archetypes.

VisualGallery.description: A scroll-hijacked, 100svh immersive editorial slider. Traps vertical scroll/touch until the user completes the 16-slide sequence.

archetypes.name: full-bleed-cutout
archetypes.description: Image spans almost full height, offset to one side. Massive editorial typography behind and in front of the image. Z-index layering is critical.

archetypes.name: contact-sheet
archetypes.description: Multiple instances or crops of the same image arranged in a strict, border-heavy grid. Lots of negative space. Monospace annotations surrounding the frames.

archetypes.name: diagonal-runway
archetypes.description: Image is clipped with a harsh diagonal clip-path. Typography follows the diagonal axis (using CSS transform rotate). High energy.

archetypes.name: helmet-artifact
archetypes.description: Clinical, precise. Small centered image. Surrounded by technical monospace specs, crosshairs, and connecting lines (using absolute positioned divs).

archetypes.name: poster-duotone
archetypes.description: Image is treated with CSS filters (grayscale, high contrast, mix-blend-mode: multiply) over a vibrant background color. Creates a screen-printed poster effect.

motion_and_interaction.scroll_hijack: Attach passive: false wheel/touchmove listeners. Prevent default scrolling if index > 0 and index < max. Release boundary to parent scroll only on extreme ends.
motion_and_interaction.transitions: Hard cuts. No slow fades. When slide changes, trigger a 0.1s white background flash (opacity 1 to 0) over the entire screen to simulate a camera flash.
motion_and_interaction.parallax: Apply subtle opposite-direction y-axis transforms to typography vs images during the slide entrance.
motion_and_interaction.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query by disabling parallax and camera flashes, reverting to simple opacity crossfades.

accessibility.focus_management: Ensure keyboard users can navigate through the trapped gallery via Up/Down arrow keys or PageUp/PageDown.
accessibility.aria_labels: All slides must have role='group' and aria-roledescription='slide'. Include hidden screen reader text summarizing the location and context of each photo.
accessibility.color_contrast: Text colors defined in the 'worlds' object meet WCAG AA standards. Ensure hover states on any navigation dots/arrows also meet 3:1.

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. Implement the scroll-trapping mechanism carefully to allow normal page scrolling ONLY when the gallery is at index 0 (scrolling up) or index 11 (scrolling down).
3. Build 5 distinct layout components mapped to the archetypes (e.g., <FullBleedCutout />, <ContactSheet />, etc.). Render them dynamically based on the image_data array.
4. Implement the 'Camera Flash' hard-cut transition between slides using Framer Motion or pure CSS animations.
5. Do NOT alter the existing 3D spatial camera coordinates from the parent layout.
6. Use Tailwind CSS for structural layouts and colors mapped to inline styles or custom Tailwind config extensions.
7. Ensure 100svh constraints so the gallery perfectly fits mobile and desktop viewports (1920x800 down to 320x700).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
